files.rationale: Kept both sets of new class fields, PR A's adaptive-resolution state (adaptive, lastFrame, frameSamples, resIndex, resolutions) and PR B's remote-status and timed-capture state (remoteSocket, intervalId, frameCount, captureMode), because the already merged method bodies use all of them.
Kept PR A's --stream/--signal-url assertion and PR B's --interval and --stream-encode assertions, renumbering B's cases to res6/res7 so the variable names do not collide.

Followed PR A's choice to make this file the compiled output of j360-cli.ts and regenerated it from the merged TypeScript, so it has A's --no-audio/withAudio handling and encoding progress plus B's --interval and --stream-encode options, timed capture, streamEncode passed to startWasmRecording, and the tar-stream/ffmpeg-static check.

Merged PR A's typed CLIValues, the --no-audio flag (still documented in the README) and withAudio logic with PR B's interval and stream-encode options and their handling in run(), and added streamEncode and interval to the page.evaluate parameters so the browser callback actually receives them.
